scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter=@takyon/shared typecheck && bun run --filter=@takyon/desktop typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.scripts.json
scripts.lint: bun run lint:ts && bun run lint:rust && bun run check:comments && bun run check:colours && bun run check:licences
scripts.lint:ts: bun run --filter=@takyon/desktop lint && bun run --filter=@takyon/shared lint
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --all --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --manifest-path apps/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test: bun run test:rust && bun run test:ts && bun run test:visual
